# markdown

The CommonMark literal datatype — documentation content carried in the graph is CommonMark, typed with this datatype so the convention is machine-visible (#325). Used ONLY in annotation literals (scope notes, examples, guide content), never in logical axioms, so the OWL 2 DL profile is untouched. HTML or SGML subsets are explicitly rejected: one markup convention, visible in the data.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/markdown>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:markdown`  

**Type:** `rdfs:Datatype`
